en-US.name: Game Dev Agent Skills
en-US.summary: Optional local Apache-2.0 package of 79 original game-dev agent skills for Godot, Unity, Unreal and other engines, with the root LICENSE and NOTICE in the installed tree and in each child. Engine runtimes are not bundled.
en-US.description: Market-local packaging of gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills@c6ca6c41c839b68319ffc08430b99ab768debc32. Package version 2026.11.24.
